latestVersion.changelog:
photo-to-video-ai-online 1.0.0 — initial release

- Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC images (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 videos using AI in the cloud.
- Simple UX: upload photos and describe the video you want (e.g. smooth transitions, aspect ratio, audio, text overlay).
- Handles authentication with free credit system and automatic token management.
- Supports common video and audio formats for uploads; export-ready videos typically process in 30–60 seconds.
- Includes user guidance, API connection workflow, action routing by user intent, and transparent error handling.
